_note: Midjourney automation configuration. Two backends: the web app (default) and the legacy Discord bot.
_note_engine: 'web' drives midjourney.com/imagine with a headed browser + cookie jar (recommended — no Discord login needed). 'discord' uses the /imagine slash command via the Midjourney Discord bot (legacy; needs a logged-in Discord session in the automation profile).

web._note_cookiesFile: Cookie jar exported from a browser logged into midjourney.com. Netscape or JSON format. SECRET — keep it out of git (see .gitignore). Export with a 'Get cookies.txt' extension, or from DevTools.
web._note_userDataDir: Browser profile for the web backend. Separate from the Discord profile so the two never fight over one Chromium instance.
web._note_generationTimeoutMs: How long to wait for a task's 4-up grid after submitting. Relax-mode jobs queue, so generous.
web._note_acceptTimeoutMs: How long to wait for a new task to appear after pressing Enter. This is the acceptance signal — a cleared textbox is not. 240s since 2026-10-18: --cref + busy MJ sessions regularly take 150-200s to render the new card; 120s was right at the boundary. Each FAIL burns 2 * ACCEPT_TIMEOUT (initial + retry), so 240s balances wall time against miss rate.

discord._note_channelUrl: The Discord channel URL where the Midjourney bot lives. Defaults to DM with MJ bot. Replace with your server's channel URL. (Personal channel ID scrubbed from this public config 2026-09-30 — the legacy Discord backend is unconfigured anyway.)

chrome._note_userDataDir: Legacy Discord backend profile. Launch Comet with this once, sign into Discord, then close. The watcher reuses the profile (cookies persist).

mj.defaultArgs: handmade 2D bedtime animation still, linocut print texture, deep blue and warm red ink on cream paper, no text --chaos 5 --ar 16:9 --raw --profile a13mc1d --edit https://s.mj.run/3Hv2HR2n3Zs --stylize 21 --hd --v 8.2
mj._note_defaultArgs: The master suffix — what every render carries unless the prompt names its own. It LEADS with the look (a handmade 2D bedtime-animation still: linocut print texture, deep blue and warm red ink on cream paper, no text), then the flags: low chaos so the picture stays calm, the house ratio, --raw and --stylize 21 (the literal-photo reference is the goal and the stylize is the enemy), one style reference (667921269) and one profile (a13mc1d) so every render lives in the same world, and --hd. A prompt that names its own copy of a flag keeps it: the master's copy of that slot is dropped, never doubled — MJ honours the LAST of a duplicated flag, so a doubled one is a silent override.

master.title: Kišna soba — the master visual brief
master.brief: Vizuelni brief Kišna soba Paleta (svi likovi): prigušeno plavo, sivo, krem, toplo žuto od lampe. Nema neon, nema oštrih kontrastova. Linija meka, zaobljena; senke meke. Lea (6) Lice: ovalno, mirne oči (veće, ali ne "cartoon šok"), male trepavice, blagi osmeh ili miran izraz. Kosa: srednje smeđa, kratka do ramena, blago talasasta, često za uvo. Telo: vitko, proporcije predškolske (veća glava, kraće noge). Odeća: krem pidžama sa sitnim kišnim kapima; čarape. Rekvizit: ponekad knjiga ili ćebence. Pokret: spor, uredan; kad je ljuta ukršti ruke, ne viče. Niko (4) Lice: okruglije, veće obraze, oči malo šire (radoznalost / "još malo?"). Kosa: svetlija, kovrdžava, uvek malo neuredna. Telo: kraće, mekše. Odeća: plava pidžama sa oblacima; jedna čarapa često skliznuta. Rekvizit: plišani zeka "Zeka". Pokret: sporiji ustajanje, češće sedeće; kad je uznemiren stegne Zeku, ne trči po sobi. Muka (mačka) Siva, kratka dlaka, bela grudića. Oči: žuto-zelene, poluzatvorene; trepne jednom kad je "rešenje". Uši male, rep debeo i spor. Nikad ne priča; jedini "dijalog" = treptaj, uvijanje, polagan korak na dasku. Pozicija default: na prozorskoj dasci, silueta na kiši. Kad uteši: uvije se između Lee i Nika, glava na nogama. Zajedno u kadru: Lea levo / Niko desno / Muka gore na prozoru ili u sredini na kraju. Kamera u nivou sedenja na krevetu; malo pokreta kamere.
master._note: THE master prompt for the current MJ work: the visual brief for the rainy room, its palette, and how Lea, Niko and Muka move and are staged. Read from the feed's own full_command (the only trustworthy record) — the job ran with moodboards kgvnzd9 and mgmce5w and profile ub2pnlv, and those moodboards are what carry the 2D-watercolour look into every frame.
master._ages: The brief says Lea 6 and Niko 4. The shot list in assets/mural-prompts/kisna-soba-12.md says Lea 5 and Niko 3. The shot list wins; the discrepancy is recorded here rather than quietly reconciled.
master.suffix: handmade 2D bedtime animation still, linocut print texture, deep blue and warm red ink on cream paper, no text --chaos 5 --ar 16:9 --raw --profile a13mc1d --edit https://s.mj.run/3Hv2HR2n3Zs --stylize 21 --hd --v 8.2
master._note_suffix: The master's flags and look, set 2026-11-09. The suffix leads with the LOOK because the scene belongs first in the prompt: the pack's prose is the subject, and the master follows it. The ratio is 1:1 — the square of the reference frame. A prompt that names its own --ar keeps it (the master is the default, not a rule), and --hd is dropped when the prompt names the v6 line, because MJ refuses that combination.

master._note_styleRef: The --sref code 667921269 no longer resolves — Midjourney refuses EVERY prompt that names it (proved: a command that worked at 03:32 was refused at 11:00 with the identical text). The look now travels in the suffix's PROSE — the linocut sentence — and the account's own --profile (a13mc1d) stays, because the web app injects it whether or not a prompt asks.

The --edit attachment is the artist's identity anchor and it is FRESH: the October s.mj.run URLs have expired and every prompt naming them is refused. --sref 667921269 is gone — it stopped resolving on this account (a command that worked at 03:32 was refused at 11:00 with identical text, and accepted with the code dropped).
